title: Gartner® Cool Vendor™ Recognition
summary: Unravel Carbon has been named in the Gartner® Cool Vendor™ Innovations in Supply Chain Sustainability report, 2026.
body_markdown:
Anyone who has built a full corporate carbon inventory and passed an audit against it knows how many tedious, manual parts get in the way of the actual strategic, enterprise value-adding work: months of collecting data, transforming it, cleaning it, wrestling with it, and chasing data owners and suppliers who aren’t exactly motivated.


Unravel Carbon has built domain-trained agents that complete an annual inventory in two months, giving our customers back the time to reduce emissions and adapt to climate risks instead of being busy with the accounting work.


‍


**What our agents actually do for our clients:**


Read supplier data straight from invoices, ERP exports and spreadsheets, and map it into standardised accounting templates, so the team starts from calculated numbers instead of a blank page.


- Run what-if comparisons on a design or a sourcing choice before it is committed, with the carbon trade-off sitting next to the cost one.
- Capture a disclosure once and carry it across CSRD, ESRS and GRI, so the same number is not re-entered five times for five frameworks.
- Collect supplier data agentically, removing supplier fatigue.


Supply chain sustainability is where carbon data starts driving real procurement and product decisions. That is the work we are building, starting from APAC, but for the world.


Thanks to the Gartner team for the recognition and analysis.


‍


Gartner,“Cool Vendor Innovations in Supply Chain Sustainability,” Kevin Lawrence, Laura Rainier, Marta Muñoz, August 2026.
